role_summary: Senior technology leadership role for GWAM Asia, serving as Chief Architect to define and execute Asia technology strategy, lead architecture governance (LARB), drive practical AI adoption, develop shared technology services, and oversee operations technology capabilities.
must_have_requirements: University degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent practical experience.
Strong architecture experience across enterprise, solution, application, data, integration, cloud, security, and modern engineering practices.
Proven track record of applying AI in real business or technology contexts, including AI application delivery, agent deployment, or AI-enabled workflow transformation.
Strong knowledge of SDLC in the AI era, including AI-assisted engineering, model and agent lifecycle, responsible AI controls, testing, monitoring, change management, and production readiness.
Demonstrated ability to lead architecture governance forums and make balanced decisions across business value, technology fit, risk, cost, scalability, and operational resilience.
Strong understanding of shared technology services, reusable platforms, engineering standards, and operating models across multiple markets.
Excellent stakeholder management, communication, facilitation, and influencing skills for senior leaders, architects, engineers, risk partners, and business stakeholders.
Strategic thinker with ability to connect global direction, regional priorities, and local market realities into a practical roadmap.
Inquisitive, pragmatic, outcome-focused mindset with continuous improvement and ability to challenge status quo constructively.
nice_to_have_requirements: Experience in asset management, wealth, retirement, or related financial services technology.
Knowledge of Asian market regulatory and compliance requirements.
Experience in coaching and mentoring technology talent.

scoring_criteria.name: Architecture Breadth and Experience
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Core requirement for Chief Architect role covering multiple technology domains and ability to align with enterprise standards.
evidence_type_to_look_for: Explicit roles as architect (enterprise, solution, application, data, etc.)
Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP)
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: Candidates may have depth in one domain but need breadth; look for cross-domain exposure.

scoring_criteria.name: AI Implementation and Delivery
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: The role drives AI adoption; proven hands-on AI application delivery is essential.
evidence_type_to_look_for: Implemented AI solutions in business context
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: Many architects have theoretical AI knowledge but lack practical deployment; prioritize those with production experience.

scoring_criteria.name: Architecture Governance and Decision-Making
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Leading the Local Architecture Review Board and making balanced decisions is a key leadership duty.
evidence_type_to_look_for: Chaired or served on architecture review boards
Balanced business value, risk, cost, scalability
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: May have participated but not led; look for examples of independent decision-making.

scoring_criteria.name: Shared Technology Services and Reuse
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Developing reusable platforms and services across Asia reduces duplication and improves efficiency.
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: Candidates may have worked in siloed environments; look for evidence of cross-functional reuse.

scoring_criteria.name: Stakeholder Influence and Communication
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Influencing senior leaders without formal authority is critical for this role.
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: Some may have strong technical but weak soft skills; look for concrete influence examples.

scoring_criteria.name: Strategic Thinking and Roadmap Alignment
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Connecting global strategy to regional and local priorities is a core responsibility.
evidence_type_to_look_for: Translated global directives to local execution
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: May have tactical focus; need to see strategic vision and execution plan.

scoring_criteria.name: SDLC and Production Readiness in AI Era
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Ensuring AI solutions are production-ready, monitored, and responsibly governed is essential.
evidence_type_to_look_for: Implementation of AI testing and monitoring
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: Candidates may be familiar with traditional SDLC but not AI-specific aspects; look for AI operational experience.

scoring_criteria.name: Collaboration and Soft Skills
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Need to bring diverse teams together and foster a collaborative culture.
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: May have individual contributor background; look for team-based achievements.

scoring_criteria.name: Operations Technology Resilience
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Oversight of operational technology ensures stability and business continuity.
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: Not all architects have ops background; but for this role it's part of the remit, so weigh positively.

summary_focus: Senior technology architect with extensive experience across enterprise, solution, data, cloud, and security architecture.
Proven track record in leading architecture governance and driving AI adoption in financial services.
Skilled at aligning global technology strategy with regional and local priorities, and fostering stakeholder buy-in.
do_not_overclaim: Do not claim to have led AI deployments unless you have specific examples.
Avoid saying 'responsible for all Asia' if you only covered one market.
Do not overstate governance leadership if you were only a participant, not the chair.

cover_letter_guidance.positioning: Position yourself as a forward-thinking technology leader who can bridge global vision and local execution, with a strong passion for AI and operational excellence.
bridge_gaps_honestly: If you lack direct AI deployment experience, emphasize your understanding of AI principles and your ability to lead AI initiatives.
If you lack Asia market exposure, highlight international experience and adaptability to new regulatory environments.
If you have limited governance experience, show examples of decision-making in complex technical environments.
